note: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 iteration count shared by the encrypted formats. Read by rust/wfm-core/src/trading/auth.rs (JWT_KDF_ITERATIONS, the on-disk WFM token) and frontend/src/adapters/encrypted-snapshot.ts (KDF_ITERATIONS, encrypted inventory exports), which are documented as using the same parameters. A mismatch would make one side derive a different key and surface as a false 'wrong passphrase' error.
